source_notes: Main Figure 1 is the ODAm route, SI Figure S5 is the technical-OLAm route. The source image crops contain figure panels but omit the printed captions.
RBS and XRD panels use NC films; their physical aliquot joins to TEM are not supplied.
Main p.8 is bibliography only. Downstream ligand exchanges, NMR heating experiments and externally prepared CdSe are outside the two as-synthesized CuInS2 routes.

evidence_conflicts.resolution: Both source labels are displayed separately for the same named OLAm sample; no ratio inversion or preference is inferred.

remaining_gaps: The cooling instruction says after 1 h without defining the one-hour origin relative to the heating ramp.
Exact workup solvent volumes, centrifugation settings and physical batch/aliquot IDs are not reported.
OLAm Figure S5 supplies no numerical particle size or named phase; neither route supplies measured atomic coordinates.
Figure display permission has not been independently verified.
training_note: Source-scoped synthesis and sample-linked characterization; no exact measured atomic coordinates or synthesis-to-coordinate pair is supplied.
